prompt:
RepositoryGroup (mealie/repos/repository_group.py) and RepositoryHousehold (mealie/repos/repository_household.py) each carry their own copy of the same two pieces of logic:
- get_by_slug_or_id: take a slug or an id (a UUID or its string form) and return the matching record;
- update: re-derive the slug from the name before saving.

Put each piece of logic in one place that both repositories use, so that a change to it is made once. This is a refactor: behavior must not change. Both repositories keep the same public methods with the same signatures and the same results, and every existing test still passes.

Tests: `python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests` (the whole backend suite, about 9 minutes). For quicker loops while you work, tests/unit_tests/repository_tests and tests/integration_tests/admin_tests cover these repositories.
title: One home for the slug-or-id lookup and the slug-on-update logic of groups and households
